picks.title: “이 소설, 당신이 썼나요” AI 시대 맞은 문학상, ‘작가 검증’ 나섰다
picks.excerpt: 국내 한 장편소설 공모전 최종심 작품이 작가의 실제 집필 과정 검증에서 의문이 제기돼 수상 기회를 잃는 등, 문학상들이 AI 시대를 맞아 심사에 '작가 검증' 절차를 도입하고 있다.
picks.rationale: A new concrete event: a Korean novel-contest finalist lost the prize after failing a check of the author's writing process, and Korean literary prizes are adding author-verification steps to judging.

picks.title: 플리토, 교보문고 광화문·강남·동대문점에 AI 통번역 ‘보글’ 적용…외국인 고객 응대 실증
picks.excerpt: 플리토가 교보문고 3개 매장에 도서 분류명·작가명을 사전 학습한 AI 통번역 '보글'을 공급해 외국인 고객 응대 실증을 진행했다. 정식 도입을 추진 중이다.
picks.rationale: A real in-store deployment: Kyobo's three flagship bookstores ran Flitto's AI interpreter, pre-trained on book categories and author names, for foreign customers, and a full rollout is being pursued.

picks.title: Can Naav AI Break English's Hold on Indian Literature? Vikram Sampath Thinks So
picks.excerpt: Naav AI translates books across Indian and foreign languages with AI, then has human experts refine the output to preserve the author's voice and cultural context.
picks.rationale: A new book-translation service built on a concrete workflow: AI produces the first draft and human experts refine it, aimed at moving Indian-language literature across languages.

picks.title: Turn your PDFs into audiobooks with ChatGPT — here's the simple trick
picks.excerpt: A new tool connects ChatGPT with AI-generated narration to turn documents and books into listenable audio.
picks.rationale: The most hands-on pick: a new tool pairs ChatGPT with AI narration so readers can turn documents and books into audio themselves.

picks.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026: Programs Explore AI's Impact on Translation, and the Future of Publishing
picks.excerpt: Research presented in Czechia's Frankfurt pavilion examined how publishing professionals use AI — and why literary translators remain concerned about its effects on their livelihoods.
picks.rationale: New research presented in the Czech pavilion at Frankfurt, with data on how publishing professionals use AI and why literary translators are worried. It is distinct from the ENLIT funding-network story of 10-11.

alternates.title: How to Listen to Kindle Books With CastReader
alternates.excerpt: A guide to CastReader, which reads Kindle Cloud Reader books aloud with cloud AI voices and offers an 'AI Explain' reading-assistant feature for unfamiliar passages.
alternates.rationale: Backup if a pick is swapped. It is a how-to guide and 12 days old.
